runtime/CMakeLists.txt:
add_library(core STATIC src/core.cpp)   # the library every program links
set(shim_sources
    shims/net.cpp
    shims/audio.cpp)
add_executable(rt src/entry.cpp ${shim_sources})
target_link_libraries(rt PRIVATE core)
add_executable(net_test
  test/net_test.cpp
  shims/net.cpp)
add_executable(core_test test/core_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(core_test PRIVATE core)
foreach(target IN ITEMS loop_a_test loop_b_test)
  add_executable(${target} test/${target}.cpp shims/audio.cpp)
endforeach()
target_sources(rt PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shims/late.cpp")
if(WIN32 AND TARGET net_test)
  add_test(NAME net COMMAND net_test)
  add_test(NAME net_again COMMAND net_test --again)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  add_test(NAME core COMMAND core_test)
else()
  add_test(NAME core COMMAND core_test --posix)   # the same test, declared per platform
endif()
add_test(NAME loop_a COMMAND loop_a_test)
add_test(NAME loop_b COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:loop_b_test> --flag)
add_test(NAME run_modes COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test/check_modes.py $<TARGET_FILE:rt>)
foreach(name one two)
  add_test(NAME rejects_${name} COMMAND rt --${name})
endforeach()
add_executable(part_test extra/part.cpp)
add_test(NAME part COMMAND part_test)
